{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}} {{pp-protected|small=yes}} {{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}} {{Use American English|date=November 2025}} '''Group B''' of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] is taking place from June 12 to 24, 2026.{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}} The group consists of [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]] (co-host), [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]], and [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]]. The top two teams, possibly along with the third-placed team, will advance to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]].{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}} ==Teams== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !rowspan=2| Draw position !rowspan=2| Team !rowspan=2| Pot !rowspan=2| Confederation !rowspan=2| Method of

{{reflist|group=nb}} ==Standings== {{2026 FIFA World Cup group tables|Group B}} In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]: * The winner of Group B will advance to play the third-placed team of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group E|Group E]], [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group F|Group F]], [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group G|Group G]], [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group I|Group I]], or [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J|Group J]]. * The runner-up of Group B will advance to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group A|Group A]]. * The third-placed team of Group B might advance to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group D|Group D]] or [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group E|Group E]] (if one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-placed teams|eight best third-placed teams]] from the group stage). ==Matches== All times listed are local. ===Canada vs Bosnia and Herzegovina=== The two teams had never met before. With a 1–1 draw, this marked the first time that Canada won a point at a World Cup, ending their six-loss streak altogether in the tournament.

It will also be used as a tiebreaker for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-placed teams|third-place ranking]] between groups if the overall records of teams are tied.
